title: Argentina's top scorers since 2000
brief: Name the ten players with the most goals for Argentina in full internationals since 1 January 2000, to the 2026 World Cup final. Only goals from 2000 on count.
period: Full internationals from 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026

notes.Ezequiel Lavezzi: Ezequiel Lavezzi is just outside with 9.
notes.Luciano Figueroa: Luciano Figueroa is just outside with 9.
notes.Gabriel Batistuta: Gabriel Batistuta scored only 6 of his 56 from 2000 on.

checks: Counted match by match: every Transfermarkt match report for the nation from 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026 (starters plus substitutes who came on; scorers, own goals left out; results checked against each match's score, shoot-outs aside), then checked year by year against National Football Teams (its per-year player tables, FIFA and non-FIFA columns added together, September and October 2026 games taken off). Career totals also checked against RSSSF's record players page and Wikipedia (player infoboxes and caps-by-year tables), with games after 19 July 2026 taken off. Crespo's 28 (35 in all, 7 before 2000) and Riquelme's 17 (all from 2000 on) checked against Wikipedia's caps-by-year tables. Aguero 41 and Higuain 31 as on the all-time board (RSSSF 42 and 32). Lautaro Martinez 40 and Julian Alvarez 15 exclude goals after 19 July 2026.
